entities.summary: Abbas Nilforoushan was an Iranian military officer in the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), who served as the IRGC's Deputy of Operations. He began his military career at the age 14 in 1980 with the paramilitary Basij, then joined the IRGC and was a member of this organization throughout the Iran–Iraq War.
